answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to incinerate a specific asset like copper to register a new identity. This creates a ripple effect of capital scarcity, ensuring that any attempt to wander across multiple fraudulent profiles incurs a non-recoverable financial loss. By decoupling identity from compute and tethering it to verifiable resource destruction, the network effectively raises the cost of entry, rendering large-scale identity spoofing economically irrational.
